acceptance: A new unrelated Work Item can create its Contract/Summary when a foreign duplicate has exactly one canonical owner.
Foreign duplicate diagnosis remains read-only and reports owner-only recovery guidance.
Malformed, ambiguous, noncanonical-without-owner, and requested-task active-owner identity states remain fail closed.
A real Git linked-worktree regression proves no foreign Contract/Summary bytes are mutated.
Focused checks, full quality, standard Finish/archive, hosted PR checks, merge, and closure pass without a manual ai-start bypass.
guidelines: Do not mutate foreign linked worktrees or their evidence.
Make allowance only for a uniquely canonical recoverable duplicate unrelated to the requested Work Item.
Preserve fail-closed behavior for malformed, ambiguous, and requested-task conflicts.
Use real linked-worktree regression evidence rather than mocked classification alone.

intent.problem: After #652 merged, ai-start still globally rejects a new Work Item because an unrelated stale foreign duplicate identity is recoverable but not allowed.
constraints: Normal ai-start failed before it could create this Contract; this bootstrap record is the governed corrective path.
Do not repair or change foreign worktrees automatically.
intent.rationale: A new Work Item must be able to start independently while preserving explicit diagnostics and fail-closed protection for real identity conflicts.

declaredIntent.summary: Permit independent governed Work Item startup while retaining fail-closed linked-worktree identity integrity.
